title: Moonstruck
about: A Brooklyn widow falls for her fiancé's angry baker brother under a big full moon.
cue: Bring out the bread when Ronny is in the bakery basement.
faces: Cosmo’s moon, over the bridge to Brooklyn.
Secondi served with a green salad
Pounded thin, floured and sautéed, with lemon, white wine, capers and butter.
Breaded cutlet under marinara and melted mozzarella, a side of ziti.
Littlenecks opened in garlic, olive oil and white wine, with parsley.
Sweet fennel sausage and peppers in a slow tomato gravy.
From a Brooklyn baker, dimpled with olive oil and coarse salt. Cut by hand.
In carrozza, golden in an egg batter, with anchovy and caper sauce.
Breadcrumbs, pecorino and garlic, steamed tender.
Ricotta, sugar and orange zest in chocolate dipped shells, filled to order.
Short and black. Wakes you up.
White toast fried in butter, an egg set in a ring of red pepper, yolk soft.
Shaken frothy with lemon and egg white, over ice, a cherry on top.
The bottle, for a toast to la famiglia.
Regulars. The whole family, on our wall.
The bread on your table comes over the bridge from my ovens every afternoon. Eat it warm. I’ll be at the opera.
Thompson St., N.Y. 10012. (212) 555-1987. Proposals taken on one knee.

Cover and rise for 2 hours.Oil a 30 x 20cm tin with most of the oil, tip in the dough and stretch to the corners.
